info.name: PROP Pricing - Line Items
info.description:
Prerequisites (set these collection variables before running):
- proposalId: an existing Proposal id (created via the Proposals module) to attach line items to.
- otherProposalId: a second, different, existing Proposal id, used only by the cross-proposal scoping test in '4 Not Found' to confirm a line item from one proposal is not reachable through another.

This collection cannot verify Proposal.contractValue directly (PROP-PRICE-1) since no GET /api/proposals/{id} endpoint is part of this module. Each Happy Path / catalog test below asserts the per-line lineTotal returned by the API instead, and where useful stores the expected contribution to the proposal total in 'expectedProposalTotalDelta' - cross-check that against a Proposals-module response if one is available.

item.name: POST .../line-items - Author creates freehand line item

exec: pm.test('catalogItemId is null for freehand line', () => pm.expect(body.catalogItemId).to.be.null);

item.name: GET .../line-items - Reviewer lists line items for proposal

exec: pm.test('Created line item appears in list', () => {

item.name: 2 Catalog Pre-fill & Override
POST /api/catalog-items - Author creates catalog item to reference
POST .../line-items - catalogItemId only pre-fills description & unitPrice

request.description: PROP-PRICE-2: no description/unitPrice supplied, so both should fall back to the catalog item.

item.name: POST .../line-items - explicit unitPrice overrides catalog default

request.description: PROP-PRICE-2: unitPrice explicitly supplied, so it must win over the catalog default; description still falls back.

exec: pm.test('description still falls back to catalog name', () => pm.expect(body.description).to.eql(catalogItemName));
pm.test('unitPrice uses the override, not the catalog default', () => pm.expect(body.unitPrice).to.eql(450));

item.name: PUT .../line-items/{{catalogOverrideLineItemId}} - explicit description overrides catalog name

request.description: unitPrice omitted this time, so it should fall back to the catalog default again even though description is explicit.

exec: pm.test('description uses the explicit override', () => pm.expect(body.description).to.eql('Custom description overriding catalog name'));
pm.test('unitPrice falls back to catalog default again', () => pm.expect(body.unitPrice).to.eql(catalogItemDefaultPrice));

request.description: catalogPrefillLineItemId is deliberately NOT deleted here - it's kept alive to drive the referential-integrity (409) test in '6 Referential Integrity' below.

item.description: PROP-PRICE-2: selecting a catalog item pre-fills description/unitPrice; explicit values still win.

item.name: 3 Validation Errors
POST .../line-items - no catalogItemId and no description returns 400
POST .../line-items - no catalogItemId and no unitPrice returns 400

item.description: Bean-validation and cross-field checks on LineItemRequest.

item.name: 4 Not Found
POST .../line-items - create scoping-test line item under proposalId

request.description: Requires otherProposalId to be set - see collection description.

item.name: PUT via otherProposalId - line item from a different proposal returns 404

request.description: Confirms findByIdAndProposalId scoping: a line item cannot be reached through a proposal it does not belong to.

item.name: DELETE .../line-items/{{scopingTestLineItemId}} - cleanup via the correct proposal

item.description: Unknown proposal/catalog/line-item ids, plus cross-proposal scoping.

item.name: 5 Authorization
POST .../line-items - Admin token returns 403 (role not permitted)
DELETE .../line-items/1 - Admin token returns 403 (role not permitted)

item.description: Endpoints require AUTHOR or REVIEWER; no token = 401, wrong role (ADMIN) = 403.

item.name: 6 Referential Integrity
DELETE /api/catalog-items/{{catalogItemId}} - blocked while a line item still references it

request.description: catalogPrefillLineItemId (from '2 Catalog Pre-fill & Override') still references this catalog item.

item.name: DELETE .../line-items/{{catalogPrefillLineItemId}} - remove the referencing line item

item.description: A catalog item referenced by a line item cannot be deleted (409) until unreferenced.
